RUN COMMAND

  0.50   0.000000e+00   1.000000e-12   -1.000000e-12  0.000000e+00   4503.600     sim_below_theory_no_upward_anomaly
  0.40   0.000000e+00   1.003670e-12   -1.003670e-12  0.000000e+00   4520.128     sim_below_theory_no_upward_anomaly

PARAMETERS

Same realization and SNR; candidate minus reference.

POLICY
BER upper interval <= 0.1 and Goodput lower interval >= 0.25.
Among feasible codebook entries, maximize pre-noise receive energy.
If none is feasible, fall back to maximum mean Goodput.
Online complexity: channel ranking O(Nsc log Nsc), codebook scan O(6).
Signaling: one of six policy indices, requiring ceil(log2(6)) = 3 bits/update.

LIMITS
Offline selection on the same formal corpus is descriptive, not held-out proof.
Energy is a receive-signal proxy, not RF-DC conversion efficiency.
